name: iStreet Network Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1988, iStreet Network Ltd is an Internet & Retail Catalogue company and sells products and services through its Internet Retail Stores known as iStreet Bazaar.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
iSNL is engaged in selling and purchasing across domestic and international markets, both on its own and as a sales, purchase, or commission agent/broker. It also acts as a service agent for after-sales support, provides marketing services, and operates as a marketing and technical consultant.

cons: Stock is trading at 58.2 times its book value
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.82 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 436 days.
